title: data for billing.balance_low
description: The integrator's free BRL balance (balance - reserved - pending) crossed below the configured low-balance threshold. Sent at most once per crossing. Money values are integer strings in micros (millionths of BRL). Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

balance_micros.description: Paid + bonus balance. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

reserved_micros.description: Reserved for accepted sends awaiting delivery. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

available_micros.description: What new sends can still use (balance - reserved - pending + credit limit). Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

low_balance_threshold_micros.description: Configured alert threshold. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

balance.description: Same as balance_micros as an exact decimal BRL string, e.g. "12.5".
